about_short_description.short_description: HEO Robotics provides Space Situational Awareness (SSA) and asteroid prospecting services using nanosatellites deployed in high Earth orbit.

product.name: HEO Inspect
product.description: A web application that allows customers to task in-orbit sensors to collect resolved imagery of space objects and receive results within 24 hours of successful capture.

product.name: Non-Earth Imaging (NEI)
product.description: A service that uses space-based sensors to capture resolved imagery of Resident Space Objects (RSOs) including active or inactive spacecraft, rocket bodies, and space debris.

product.name: HOLMES Imagers
product.description: In-space imagers hosted on various orbital transfer vehicles to provide non-Earth imaging data, integrated with HEO Inspect for satellite inspection and monitoring.
